lines: Ye intezaar ghalat hai ke shaam ho jaaye.

couplets.en: Why wait for evening if the cups can go round now?

lines: Mujh jaise rind ko bhi tune hashr mein, ya Rab,
Bula liya hai to kuchh intezaam ho jaaye.
couplets.en: Lord, since you have summoned even a drinker like me to Judgment, see that something is laid on.

lines: Hui mehngi bahut hi sharaab, ke thodi thodi piya karo.
couplets.en: Wine has grown dear, so drink it a little at a time.
